opening_hours_decision.decision: Do not use generic hours. All 152 locator rows contain the exact same Mon–Sun 09:30 AM–06:30 PM schedule, which is an implausible uniformity signal. No hours are proposed.

scope_and_caveats: This is an official locator listing observed at capture time; it provides no per-record last-updated timestamp and phones were not call-tested. Treat proposals as official-source candidate values, not independently telephone-verified.
All 42 proposed numbers had a valid +65 plus eight-digit format and were unique within the proposed set.
Only blank Contact Details cells are proposed. Existing contacts are never overwritten.
No workbook was modified. No opening hours, menu items, images, ratings, website values, or coordinates are proposed.
